resolutions.researcher_notes: Status 'operating' inferred (rule: status is contextual, not literal). Both OGJ pieces state Haradh GOSP-3 (Haradh-III), the third gas-oil separation plant in the Haradh area of Ghawar, 'came on stream in January' 2006 with 140 MMscfd of gas 'compressed for transport by pipeline' to the 'Uthmaniyah gas plant. Two separate OGJ articles (startup + commissioning); same publisher, so treat as strong corroboration rather than fully cross-outlet independence.

Fuel=Gas confirmed: '140 MMscfd of associated natural gas' from GOSP-3 is 'compressed for transport by pipeline' to the 'Uthmaniyah gas plant, and the second OGJ piece names 'the gas pipeline to 'Uthmaniyah' explicitly. Same-publisher caveat as above.

Could not independently confirm the specific value LengthKnown=124 km. OGJ reports 'more than 160 km of oil AND gas pipeline to the Abqaiq stabilization plant and 'Uthmaniyah gas plant' (a combined oil+gas figure to two destinations, not a standalone gas-to-Uthmaniyah length); the PMI 'Haradh Gas Plant projects' paper gives a 755 km network of 18-56 in pipelines and 680 km of gathering lines — none yields 124 km. The only surface carrying exactly 124 km is gem.wiki (not citable). Seed OPEC ASB citations are country-level statistics with no pipeline-segment specs. No fabricated URL supplied.

Could not confirm Diameter=24, 32 in from any independent source. OGJ GOSP-3 articles do not state the diameter. VALUE CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: the well-documented Haradh->'Uthmaniyah rich-gas line associated with the later Haradh/Hawiyah increment (2019+) is repeatedly described as 56-inch, not 24/32-inch; the 24/32-in figure most likely reflects the older GOSP-3-era (2006) line but is unverified. No fabricated URL supplied.

FuelSource=Haradh confirmed: gas originates at Haradh GOSP-3 in the Haradh area of the Ghawar field (production from '32 new wells'), then is piped to the 'Uthmaniyah gas plant. Same-publisher caveat.

Endpoints confirmed: pipeline runs from Haradh (GOSP-3, southern Ghawar) to the 'Uthmaniyah gas plant. Both endpoints lie in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province; Haradh sits in the Al-Ahsa (Ahsa) region — consistent with StartPrefecture/District=Ahsa, EndLocation=Uthmaniya, both StartState/Province & EndState/Province=Eastern Province. Directionality of exactly 24/32-in gas line unverified but corridor and endpoints supported.

Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100% confirmed: both OGJ articles report Saudi Aramco developed, commissioned, and operates the Haradh-III GOSP-3 complex and its associated 'Uthmaniyah gas pipeline; no other equity holder named (Haradh/Ghawar is a wholly Saudi Aramco upstream asset). Same-publisher caveat on the two OGJ pieces.
